d.d: In textile inspections, a rough or coarse defect in the woven fabric.
A younger student acting as a servant for senior students (potentially in a sexual or abusive way).
(of a younger student) To act as a servant for senior students in many British boarding schools. To be the servant in fagging.
To have (a younger student) act as a servant in this way, in fagging.
A bundle of sticks or brushwood intended to be used for fuel tied together for carrying. (Some sources specify that a faggot is tied with two bands or withes, whereas a bavin is tied with just one.)
A bundle of pieces of iron or steel cut off into suitable lengths for welding.
A meatball made with offcuts and offal, especially pork.
A person who entices children into criminal activity, often teaching them how to conduct those crimes, and profits from their crimes in return for support.
Alternative spelling of faggot (“bundle of sticks”).
Alternative spelling of faggot (“bundle of iron or steel”).
To make a fagot of (objects); to bind (objects) together in a fagot or bundle.
third-person singular simple present indicative of fag
